run.question: Is checkout healthy right now? Please check the checkout service and report anything unusual.

report.summary: As of the last sampled instant 2026-11-24T18:11:53Z, checkout in namespace otel-demo shows a healthy steady state: its Deployment is 1/1 ready, its pod checkout-6578865d87-fkvcv is Running/Ready with restartCount 0 and an empty lastState, its order flow is succeeding in the application log up to 18:10:48Z, and the alert-rule ratio for failed PlaceOrder server spans evaluated to 0 (rule CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh inactive). The only checkout error evidence in the whole record is 2 error traces at 17:32:57Z and 17:33:12Z, whose exact error text is a cart connection refusal (dial tcp 10.96.156.99:8080: connect: connection refused) during the namespace-wide start-up at 17:31-17:33; after that point every 5-minute ERROR-rate sample for checkout is 0 and the 24h span increase is 2.04 ERROR vs 692.24 UNSET. The payment dependency shows no error evidence of its own: checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client spans carry only rpc_grpc_status_code=0, payment spans average 0.59-0.90 ms (grpc server) and 0.29-0.46 ms (charge), payment logged "Transaction complete." up to 18:10:48Z, and app_payment_transactions_total stayed at 0.010-0.033/s. All 11 flagd fault-injection flags (paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, cartFailure, productCatalogFailure, etc.) are at defaultVariant "off". Caveats: the record contains no samples before 2026-11-24T17:36:53Z (the demo pods were created 17:31-17:33), so the requested previous-hour comparison and any latency trend cannot be established; the firing OpsPilotAgentAbsent alerts concern the OpsPilot self-monitoring targets, not checkout; and no change-history integration is available to say who triggered the 17:31 rollout.

claims.text: Deployment checkout (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-checkout) reports spec.replicas 1, ready 1, available 1, updated 1 with conditions MinimumReplicasAvailable=True and NewReplicaSetAvailable ("ReplicaSet checkout-6578865d87 has successfully progressed").

Pod checkout-6578865d87-fkvcv is phase Running with Ready=True, container checkout restartCount 0 and empty lastState, startTime 2026-11-24T17:31:52Z, owner ReplicaSet checkout-6578865d87, on node opspilot-m1-control-plane.

The alerting rule CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (expression: rate of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} divided by the same without the ERROR filter > 0.5) is in state inactive with no active alerts, and evaluating that same expression at 2026-11-24T18:11:53Z returns the value 0 for service_name checkout.

In the 5-minute rate-by-status series for service_name checkout over 12:11:53Z-18:11:53Z, STATUS_CODE_ERROR is 0.00926/s only at the first returned point 17:36:53Z and exactly 0 at every point from 17:41:53Z through 18:11:53Z, while STATUS_CODE_UNSET runs 0.055-0.44/s; the same query returned a STATUS_CODE_UNSET series but no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for service_name payment.

The 30-minute increase of checkout ERROR spans is 1.11 for span oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and 1.11 for span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder in the 30 minutes ending 17:41:53Z, and 0 for both in the 30 minutes ending 18:11:53Z.

Over the whole authorized window the increase of traces_span_metrics_calls_total for service_name checkout is 2.04 spans with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR against 692.24 spans with STATUS_CODE_UNSET (span counters, not request counts).

Jaeger returned exactly 2 traces containing checkout error spans in 17:31:00Z-18:11:53Z: at 17:32:57.456Z and 17:33:12.276Z, with otel.status_description "cart failure: failed to get user cart during checkout: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.96.156.99:8080: connect: connection refused\"", checkout PlaceOrder otel.status_code=ERROR rpc.grpc.status_code=13, checkout GetCart rpc.grpc.status_code=14, and corresponding http.status_code=500 spans on frontend-proxy (ingress, router frontend egress) and load-generator POST.

Cluster events for namespace otel-demo show a namespace-wide start-up between 17:31:52Z and 17:33:09Z: 25 Pod Created/Started events, 23 ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate events and Deployment "Scaled up replica set ... from 0 to 1" for each workload, plus 2 ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete events.

The checkout pod's only events are Scheduled 17:31:52Z, Pulling/Pulled 17:31:52-17:32:11Z, Created and Started 17:32:11Z; there is no Unhealthy, Killing, Evicted or OOM event for checkout. The 5 Warning Unhealthy events in otel-demo are all start-up readiness-probe misses on other pods: alertmanager-0 (17:33:09Z, connection refused :9093), otel-collector-845f9747bd-b8wlj (17:32:47Z connection refused :13133 and 17:33:07Z HTTP 503), otel-collector-8664bc64d9-2qfz7 (17:33:06Z connection refused :13133), prometheus-readonly-proxy-866755586c-89sgr (17:33:04Z connection refused :8080).

Deployment otel-collector replaced ReplicaSet otel-collector-845f9747bd with otel-collector-8664bc64d9 at 17:33:05-17:33:06Z (SuccessfulDelete of pod otel-collector-845f9747bd-b8wlj plus SuccessfulCreate of otel-collector-8664bc64d9-2qfz7) and Deployment prometheus likewise replaced prometheus-547d4cbb8 with prometheus-9bc78b5f7 at 17:33:05-17:33:06Z, both with the same image strings (otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.131.0, quay.io/prometheus/prometheus:v3.5.0).

Checkout application log lines from 17:54:42Z through 18:10:48Z repeatedly show the successful order sequence: "[PlaceOrder] user_id=... user_currency=...", then "payment went through (transaction_id: ...)", then "order confirmation email sent to ..."; no error, failure or panic line appears in the 169 log lines read for this pod.
Payment pod payment-6f7bc865d6-4trdd logs level=info pairs "Charge request received." and "Transaction complete." (with transactionId) up to 2026-11-24T18:10:48.830Z.

Span-duration averages over 17:41:53Z-18:11:53Z: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 17.1-21.8 ms, checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 1.82-2.59 ms, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 0.59-0.90 ms and payment charge 0.29-0.46 ms, with no visible upward movement inside the sampled period.

Checkout's rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count series by rpc_grpc_status_code show oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge only with rpc_grpc_status_code=0 (0.0053-0.033/s at every returned point); the only non-zero gRPC status in that view is oteldemo.CartService/GetCart with rpc_grpc_status_code=14 at 0.00465/s at 17:36:53Z, falling to 0 from 17:46:53Z onward.

app_payment_transactions_total for service_name payment holds a steady 0.0102-0.0333 transactions/s across 17:36:53Z-18:11:53Z (only a service_name label set is returned; no type or status label breakdown exists in this view).

ConfigMap flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) holds 11 fault-injection flags, all with defaultVariant "off" while state is ENABLED: productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, adManualGc, adHighCpu, adFailure (off=false), kafkaQueueProblems (off=0), cartFailure (off=false), paymentFailure (off=0), paymentUnreachable (off=false), loadGeneratorFloodHomepage (off=0), imageSlowLoad (off=0).

The alert rule OpsPilotAgentAbsent (opspilot self-monitoring, query up{job="opspilot"} == 0 or absent(up{job="opspilot",role="worker"})) is firing for instance opspilot-worker:9464, opspilot-observer:9464 and opspilot-web:9464 with activeAt 2026-11-24T17:34:12Z; these labels carry opspilot_self=true and concern the OpsPilot agent listeners, not the checkout service.

http_server_request_duration_seconds_count carries service_name values only cart and flagd, i.e. checkout exports no HTTP server request-duration series under that metric name, so no HTTP-level checkout error ratio exists in this view.

Checkout is not error-free over the whole record: the 24h ERROR-span increase is 2.04, and the 2 error traces at 17:32:57Z and 17:33:12Z propagated as HTTP 500 at frontend-proxy and load-generator, so "healthy" applies to the current steady state from about 17:33 onward, not to the first ~80 seconds after the containers started.

A payment-dependency fault as the cause of the checkout failures was considered and rejected: the checkout error text names the cart endpoint (dial tcp 10.96.156.99:8080: connect: connection refused) with gRPC 14/13, checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client spans carry only grpc status 0, payment spans stay at 0.29-0.90 ms, and payment logged completed transactions through 18:10:48Z.

The 17:32:57Z/17:33:12Z checkout errors were a start-up ordering transient of the namespace-wide bring-up at 17:31-17:33Z: checkout started at 17:32:11Z, the cart container only started at 17:33:07Z, so the cart ClusterIP 10.96.156.99:8080 was still refusing connections when the load generator first called checkout; no fault-injection flag was on and no checkout-internal error appears afterwards.

Re-evaluate the checkout PlaceOrder error ratio and the checkout pod log after 2026-11-24T18:11:53Z (outside this Run's authorized window) before treating the current healthy reading as durable, and keep the CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh rule as the trigger for a deeper look.

If the start-up 500s matter operationally, address the bootstrap ordering (checkout ready at 17:32:11Z, cart container started at 17:33:07Z) with start-up ordering or client retry, rather than treating it as a code fault.

gaps: Previous-hour comparison impossible: every multi-hour Prometheus query run here returned its earliest sample at 2026-11-24T17:36:53Z (source_start_at); the checkout/payment pods were created 17:31-17:32Z, so 16:11-17:36Z has no samples and is unknown, not zero, and no latency baseline exists before 17:36:53Z.

The change-history integration is not integrated, so who or what triggered the 17:31-17:33Z namespace-wide creation of all 21 otel-demo Deployments (and the otel-collector/prometheus ReplicaSet replacements at 17:33:05-06Z) could not be determined; the replaced pods no longer exist, so their image digests could not be compared to decide config-only versus image change (kube_pod_container_info was not readable for deleted pods).

Payment absence of errors is not directly observable as zero: traces_search_by_tags for service payment with error=true over 17:31-18:11Z returned no traces (no_data, not proof of absence), and the status-split span query returned no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for payment (a missing series is unknown, not zero). rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count with service_name="payment" returned no data, so payment latency had to be taken from trace-span duration averages.

Checkout has no HTTP server request metric (http_server_request_duration_seconds_count service_name values are only cart and flagd), so the requested failed/total checkout request ratio could only be approximated from trace span counters, which count spans (client, server and internal) rather than unique requests.

The standing instruction's checks were all attempted: error ratio over the window and versus the previous hour (previous hour unavailable, see above), recent deployments/rollouts/restarts in otel-demo (done via kube-state-metrics-style deployment/pod fields and all-namespace events), and payment dependency errors/latency (done via span status, span duration, rpc_client status codes, transaction metric and pod logs).

The two checkout error traces were sampled from Jaeger's recent-trace store; spans omitted by the adapter and traces already evicted remain unknown, so the error count of 2.04 spans is a lower-bound-style observation from the sampled view.

Prometheus alert-rule and Kubernetes object reads reflect the moment of the query (18:11-18:13Z), not earlier points in the authorized window, so they cannot prove the checkout Deployment or rule state at any earlier time.
next_steps: Re-run the checkout PlaceOrder error-ratio expression and read the checkout pod log after 18:11:53Z to confirm the healthy reading persists once new samples exist.
Watch the CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh rule (threshold >0.5 over 5m, for 2m) as the trigger to investigate checkout again; it is currently inactive with ratio 0.

Investigate the separately firing OpsPilotAgentAbsent alerts for opspilot-worker:9464, opspilot-observer:9464 and opspilot-web:9464 (active since 17:34:12Z) if OpsPilot self-monitoring coverage matters; they are unrelated to checkout health.

Obtain change history (not integrated in this Run) to identify what created the otel-demo workloads at 17:31-17:33Z and whether the otel-collector/prometheus ReplicaSet replacements were configuration-only.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null).
